report.scope: Intent: apply the five conditions of code-reviewer round 1 (GO-WITH-CONDITIONS) to the PBI-013 usage-limit forecast, test-first, in site/index.html and tests/page.test.mjs only. Acceptance: CR-PBI013-01 time each gap from when work resumed (the later of the latest reset before the hit and the start of the first hourly bucket with main + sub > 0 at or after it; the first such bucket when there is no reset), with FORECAST_HOW and the forecastOf comment matching, plus an idle-gap page check whose answer differs from the reset-anchored one; CR-PBI013-02 never add the mean gap to a latest hit that has no resetsAt, and the SEVERAL fixture no longer pins that case; CR-PBI013-03 the passed-with-no-hit-since qualifier stays true on an idle board, with no timer logging console.error or throwing in the page test; CR-PBI013-04 'no forecast: usage not exported yet' when usage is absent, an accurate note for the too-little-timing-data state, and 'from N of the M recorded limit hits' when N < M; CR-PBI013-05 a skewed fixture (mean differs from median), a mixed fixture asserting the time and the N-of-M wording, and the idle-gap fixture. No exporter change. Grounding path: ran-suite (node tests/page.test.mjs, python -m unittest discover -s tests, python -m unittest discover -s local/tests, all from the worktree).
report.summary: 2 files modified (site/index.html, tests/page.test.mjs). 5 page checks added and 6 section-11 checks updated. Page suite 68 passed / 0 failed (63 before + 5 new); tests 215 passed / 0 failed; local/tests 90 passed / 0 failed. Verification tier 3 (executable code), all three configured suites run. Red confirmed before the fix: the page suite failed on the new wording; the round-1 forecastOf run on the new fixtures gave IDLE 2099-01-02T18:23:20Z (expected 16:30Z) and NORESET 08:30Z shown as a time; the timer check was red because the round-1 interval never redraws. A read-only probe of the new forecastOf on out/projects/platform-catalogue.json gives a mean gap of 2.11 h and a forecast of 2026-09-10T23:36Z, matching the reviewer's resumption-based figure. Both files remain CRLF. Change-report not validated by the writer against tools/change_report_schema.py (out of bounds); the orchestrator validates it. Nothing committed, staged, pushed or deployed.

changes.why: forecastOf times each gap from when work resumed instead of from the reset: the later of the latest reset before the hit and the start of the first hour with usage (main + sub > 0) that ends after it, or the first used hour when no reset came before; when the hourly usage has no qualifying hour it falls back to the reset. The mean is added to the latest reset. New states: 'absent' (no usage exported) and 'reset-unknown' (the latest hit's resetsAt is unreadable, so only the mean is returned and shown as 'N after reset'). Returns n (hits that gave a gap) and m (limitsOf count). Adds dur, hitsFrom ('N limit hits' or 'N of the M recorded limit hits'), NO_FORECAST and forecastNote (one usage-tab note per state); FORECAST_HOW and the forecastOf comment are rewritten to match the method. renderAll records whether the shown forecast has passed, and the existing 60-second interval calls renderAll only when that changes, so the passed marker appears on an idle board with a single redraw. The tone stays var(--rule-2), no motion, and numbers and times go through esc().

env() records setInterval callbacks (returned as timers) so a check can run the page's minute timer. Section 11 gets a series() hourly helper and new or updated fixtures, each with its hand-computed working in a comment: SEVERAL skewed (gaps 1 h/1 h/7 h, 16:00Z; the median would give 14:00) with its last hit given a reset; ONE (16:30Z, passed); IDLE (16:30Z; the reset-anchored answer 18:23:20Z and the bucket-start variant 16:36:40Z are asserted to differ); MIXED (13:00Z, 'from 2 of the 3 recorded limit hits'); NORESET ('2 h 30 min after reset'). Also adds checks for the usage-absent tile, the per-state usage-tab notes, and the minute timer (no redraw while ahead, a passed marker once past, no repeat redraw, no console.error with malformed data).

acceptance.criterion: CR-PBI013-01 (MEDIUM): each gap is timed from when work resumed, FORECAST_HOW and the comment match, and a failing-first idle-gap page check differs from the reset-anchored answer
acceptance.evidence: IDLE check passes with 2099-01-02T16:30Z; the round-1 method gives 18:23:20Z for the same fixture. On the real platform-catalogue export the new forecastOf gives a 2.11 h mean and 23:36Z.

acceptance.criterion: CR-PBI013-02 (LOW): the mean gap is not added to a latest hit that has no resetsAt, and SEVERAL no longer pins that case
acceptance.evidence: NORESET check passes ('2 h 30 min after reset'); SEVERAL's latest hit now has resetsAt 13:00Z.

acceptance.criterion: CR-PBI013-03 (LOW): the passed qualifier stays true on an idle board, and no timer can log console.error or throw
acceptance.evidence: The minute-timer check passes; the timer runs with every malformed-limits and untimed fixture under noPageErrors.

acceptance.criterion: CR-PBI013-04 (LOW): usage-absent text, FR-118 text kept, accurate untimed note, N-of-M wording
acceptance.evidence: The usage-absent, no-hit, untimed and MIXED checks pass with the exact texts asserted.

acceptance.criterion: CR-PBI013-05 (LOW): skewed, mixed and idle-gap fixtures with hand-computed working
acceptance.evidence: SEVERAL (mean 16:00Z vs median 14:00Z), MIXED (13:00Z, '2 of the 3') and IDLE (16:30Z) pass, with working in comments.

acceptance.criterion: AC-80 / FR-117 / FR-118 and the design rules remain met
